About The Platform

Discover More About LUMIÈRE

LUMIÈRE is a next-generation digital invitation platform designed specifically for couples who want to make their special occasions memorable. By combining breathtaking digital animations, customized floral backgrounds, and seamless mobile responsiveness, our platform lets you deliver unforgettable wedding invites right to your guests' phones via WhatsApp.

🎨 20+ Unique Styles

Choose from our diverse collection ranging from royal gold themes to modern minimalist botanical styles.

⚡ Instant Delivery

Generate your custom interactive card link instantly and share it effortlessly with your friends and family.

💎 Premium Quality

Built with high performance web technologies to ensure buttery-smooth motions on any mobile device.

    Got Questions?

    Frequently Asked Questions

    How do guests open the invitation?

    You get a unique website link that you can share instantly via WhatsApp, SMS, or Social Media. Guests just tap the link to view the gorgeous card.

    Can I preview my invitation before making payment?

    Yes! You can fully customize and preview your invitation for free on our platform. You only pay when you are completely satisfied and ready to publish.

    How long will the invitation website remain active?

    Your digital invitation website remains active for 1 full year from your wedding date, allowing guests to relive the memories.
